title: Council Configuration
description: Full configuration file for the council protocol (providers array + settings).

providers.description: List of LLM providers to consult.

otari.description: Route all non-local providers through Otari, an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway. When set, each provider call is dispatched through the `otari` provider with the shared api_base/api_key; the per-provider `provider` field is treated as a label.

api_base.description: Otari gateway origin with no path, or ${ENV_VAR} reference. The client adds the API path. When omitted, falls back to the OTARI_API_BASE environment variable, then GATEWAY_API_BASE.

api_key.description: Otari API key or ${ENV_VAR} reference. When omitted, falls back to the OTARI_API_KEY environment variable for the hosted otari.ai platform, or GATEWAY_API_KEY for a self-hosted gateway.

consensus_threshold.description: Minimum number of providers that must agree for consensus.
